messages:
anya_partnerships: Heads up  were piloting a lightweight SI "satellite" onboarding for small integrators in APAC/EU. Target: 4-week ramp with a short cert and marketplace enablement. Want to keep it low-touch and repeatable. Thoughts? :globe_with_meridians:

devon_solutions: Sounds smart. Keeps partner ops lean. Cohort or rolling intake?

anya_partnerships: Cohorts to start (every 6 weeks) so trainers and lab access can be batched. Signup form Monday.

kelly_ops: Logistics: HW kit customs in APAC need ~10 days. Recommend digital-first labs (prebuilt VMs + remote GPU seats) + optional HW voucher for those who need on-prem testing.

chris_sales: GTM ask: coordinate a small announcement per cohort (partner spotlight + marketplace listing). Marketing needs a quote + logo. Lock dates 3w out.

sam_lewis: Quick ops checklist for cohort 1: create private sandbox org, 12 dev seats, upload AMIs, share terraform demo module. Will need participant emails to provision.

anya_partnerships: Also need a simple voucher flow and a short cert (30 min). Badge asset for partner comms.

kelly_ops: Voucher prototype:
```
voucher: SAT-APAC-001
redeem: marketplace -> claim -> email ops@redwood.com
valid: 60d
```
I can wire procurement around that.

marketplace-bot: Listing checklist updated: catalog-image, quickstart, pricing-flag, partner-link. Internal: https://marketplace.redwood.internal/checklist

devon_solutions: Curriculum draft: week0 orientation + marketplace onboarding; wk1 deployment & model pinning; wk2 observability & rollouts; wk3 troubleshooting + cert exam. Each week = 2h live + labs.

chris_sales: Announcement fallback: if marketplace approval lags, publish partner blog + demo clip and mark listing "coming soon". Marketing ok with that.

sam_lewis: Terraform demo posted in #devex: https://git.internal/redwood/si-satellite-demo (internal). Will attach README and a one-liner to spin a demo stack.

kelly_ops: Ill open procurement GH issue and tag finance. ETA for voucher infra = 5 business days. Starting customs playbook for optional kits.

anya_partnerships: Action items: Ill publish signup + cohort calendar Mon; @devon_solutions to finalize 4-module curriculum; @kelly_ops to confirm lab & voucher flow; @sam_lewis to provision sandbox once emails come in; @chris_sales to coordinate marketing assets. Next sync after form is live. :rocket:
